prompt: The Fallow Quay editor needs a dry-run query plan and a decision on which recorded search outputs can supply a complete, cited note. Reconcile the handover with the source register and replay log. This is strictly offline: read the local files only. Do not execute search commands, start a service, contact a proxy, or access the web. Return a bare JSON object: routes maps request IDs to gpt, x, direct-fetch, or docs; search_options maps search request IDs to just the corpus-restriction CLI flags (literal flag names as keys, repeatable values as arrays in register order, and other values as strings); replay maps replay IDs to publishable, needs-sources, retry-with-higher-cap, or failed. Also include queries, mapping search request IDs to your proposed query text; the editor will review that text separately.
terse: Choose the retrieval method that matches the source you need. Keep source provenance attached to the answer and check the returned evidence before relying on it.

notes.source-specific-routes: SKILL.md#use-it and #when-this-is-not-the-right-tool: X posts and open-web discovery are separate corpora; a known page or a named API does not require open-ended search.
notes.enforced-corpus-filters: SKILL.md#use-it and #what-you-need-to-know: encode the restrictions in the engine-specific flag family, not just query prose, site: hints, or an incompatible common filter set. The query prose is not pinned.
notes.replay-evidence: SKILL.md#what-you-need-to-know: distinguish a successful uncited answer, a usable but truncated answer whose missing tail matters, and an actual command failure. Neither exit zero nor an attached citation alone establishes completeness.
